Digital audio plugins developed by NeutronStar714.

Dynamic Resonator

Dynamic Resonator is an autowah, but taken one step further. Using four EQ bands all linked to input signal strength with adjustable frequency, gain, Q, and sensitivity, the plugin creates genuine freedom for the musician to explore the dynamics of their instrument.

Inside the interface

Four filters, envelope controls, and a response display.

Extreme Shifter

A digital remake and merger of the BOSS OC-5 and BOSS XS-1 pedals. Three voices, each with its own balance, semitone, fine-tuning, and tone controls.

Inside the interface

Independent voice controls and a pitch display.

Snow

Bells Ringing, reverb, robot talking, the effect of this plugin is open to interpretation. I took the idea of Harmor's "Noise" option for resonance and transfromed it from additive synthesis to subtractive synthesis (stochastic mask).

Inside the interface

Mask, space, and dry and wet output controls.

Super Vibrato

Vibrato, tremelo, pan all in one. Uses the original shape/skew control for LFO shape.
